public.text: Client Registry, MPI, and EMPI are presented as alternative terms. An MPI may be an index linking identifiers without maintaining all authoritative demographic attributes, while a Client Registry may have broader registration responsibilities.
public.suggestedRevision: Explain the functional overlap and differences rather than treating the terms as fully interchangeable. Allow countries to map existing arrangements by capability.
